headline: testing $0.091 to $0.094 support
lede: Canton Coin (CC) price, chart levels and three scenarios for the week ahead, plus what's happening with CNTN stock. Plain English, no hype.
summary: Canton Coin is at $0.0962 (about R1.64), down about 5% this week and 21% this month. The trend is still making lower highs and price sits below its key moving averages, with support at $0.091 to $0.094 being tested. The new burn rules only start around Q1 2027, so supply still grows. CNTN stock rose about 6% to $1.98 on news of tokenized shares.
summary_plain: Canton Coin at $0.0962, down about 5% this week. Support $0.091 to $0.094, resistance $0.1046. Three scenarios, fundamentals and CNTN stock for 1 November 2026.
snapshot_note: Snapshot 1 November 2026 from CoinGecko, cross checked with CoinMarketCap (they differ by under 1%).
chart_alt: Canton Coin daily closes from 12 October to 1 November 2026, falling from about $0.125 to $0.096, with support at $0.091 to $0.094 and resistance at $0.1046 and $0.112
changed: 📉 Price slipped from about $0.100 to $0.096. The 29 October close of $0.094 was the lowest close of the month.
📉 Market cap fell from about $4.0 billion to $3.85 billion.
🔻 Futures open interest dropped from about $61 million to $46 million: traders are stepping back.
📈 CNTN stock rose from $1.86 to $1.98 (about +6%) on the tokenized shares news.
technicals: Lower highs since February, and since 13 October ($0.125, $0.112, $0.105)
Rose on the 29 October dip, quieter since
levels: 21 October spike and the 50 day average
29 October close, where buyers stepped in
scenarios: Sideways chop while the market waits for burn details
Opens $0.088, with little support below that
fundamentals: 🔥 Burn vs mint: universal burn (CIP-0129) was approved on 21 October but only starts around Q1 2027. Until then the network creates about twice as much CC as it burns.
🏦 Banks: institutions use the network (DTCC tokenization, Treasury repo trials), but those deals settle in USDC or tokenized assets, not CC.
🧩 Ecosystem: new grant for private supply proofs (Ligero), CBTC trading on Rocky, 13 Super Validators. No new unlocks or major listings this week.
cntn_notes: CNTN is Canton Strategic Holdings, a Nasdaq company that holds about 3.7 billion CC. It is not Digital Asset, the private company that built Canton Network.
Tokenized CNTN shares can trade on Canton Network through TSV LLC from 2 November at the earliest. Only cleared participants can trade, and South African access has not been announced.
You can buy CNTN through Interactive Brokers from most countries, or any US broker. See the step-by-step guide.
bottom_line: 📉 The trend is still down, and support at $0.091 to $0.094 is being tested.
🔥 The burn story is real but slow: minting still beats burning until 2027.
👀 Watch whether tokenized CNTN launches and who can access it.
